name: inner_arc

name: outer_arc

name: pot_fillet_volume

name: pot_lower_volume

name: pot_volume

title: Parabolic solar cooker
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A parabolic solar cooker whose dish is made of flat petals of mirror sheet, bent and riveted: each petal is the developable strip between two meridians of the paraboloid, so its cut outline is exact. The dish tilts on an axle through the focus, so the pot stays level and in the light at every sun height. Cut with or without kerf compensation: every laser-cut hole and slot is a clearance, a 0.25 mm weld gap or a 3 mm rivet pilot drilled out at assembly, and none depends on the kerf. Export: File > Export, Sheet of set: Petal template (DXF or SVG, cut it as many times as the form's Petals) and Sheet of set: Plates to laser cut (arms, quadrants, pot ring, hub ring). WARNING: a concentrator burns skin and eyes and sets things alight: never look into the dish or the focus, wear dark glasses, turn it away from the sun when you leave it.
